text:
alyssa: Heads-up — spotted billing drift in staging this morning. Start a streaming session, call a tool that does KV-prefetch, trigger KV eviction, then client reconnect/resume. Suffix tokens after resume get counted twice sometimes. I reproduced twice.
jamal: Ugh. Is this the same resume-path we saw last month or a new variant? Any traces? :thinking:
alyssa: Looks related but different. This one happens when: model-swap triggers mid-stream -> router hands off to new shard -> kv snapshot gets trimmed for memory -> resume path reconstructs suffix and we emit a provisional token event + a confirmed event after ledger reconciliation. So provisional and confirmed overlap. Paste of relevant logs: 
```
[router] ts=2026-03-19T09:12:23Z session=abc123 event=handoff target_shard=s2 resume=true snapshot_prefix_len=512 resumed_from_seq=120 truncated=true
[billing] ts=2026-03-19T09:12:23Z session=abc123 provisional_tokens=42
[toolcall] ts=2026-03-19T09:12:24Z session=abc123 tool=embedder status=ok produced_tokens=18
[billing] ts=2026-03-19T09:12:25Z session=abc123 confirmed_tokens=60
```
rick: That confirmed_tokens jump looks like we double-counted the suffix (42 provisional + 18 confirmed = 60). Do we not dedupe provisional vs confirmed?
nora: Our protos send a `provisional` event for resume and then the ledger emits a `confirmed` when final ack arrives. We should have an id to dedupe. Right now provisional events lack a stable dedupe id across handoffs.
jamal: Two options I see: (1) mark provisional events as non-billable in console until confirmed (ugly for quick visibility) or (2) ensure provisional carries `resume_id` that survives handoff and ledger dedupes confirmed/provisional if resume_id matches. I prefer (2).
alyssa: (2) seems sound. But watch out for user-facing UX: folks will see their dashboard token counts fluctuate when provisional is removed. We need a console hint: show "provisional tokens" as translucent and clearly labeled.
rick: Implementation details: router must attach `X-Resume-ID` to internal call metadata and the billing pipeline must check last_seen_resume_id per session and drop duplicates. Also need telemetry metric `billing.provisional_dedupe_hits` so ops can monitor.
nora: Agree. Proposal for internal header: 
```
X-Resume-ID: <uuid>
X-Provisional: true|false
```
Then billing pipeline: if X-Provisional && later confirmed with same X-Resume-ID => ignore provisional counters or mark provisional as temporary in ledger.
jamal: Minor wrinkle: toolcalls can produce tokens independently (tool responses). We need to preserve attribution (who charged what) so we can't just ignore provisional sums blindly. Maybe provisional should be per-attribution-tag, e.g., `resume_id:abc::tool:embedder`.
alyssa: Good call. Also consider rollouts: if we change billing behavior, we must be able to toggle provisional visibility per-org via console flag so enterprise customers get stability.
rick: Actionable plan: (A) Add X-Resume-ID to router (PR), (B) billing pipeline change to emit `provisional` events with resume_id and a `provisional_flag=true` attribute, (C) ledger dedupe on resume_id + attribution, (D) console: show provisional column and a filter to hide provisional from charts.
deploy-bot: canary: billing-provisional-dedupe rolled to 5% us-west-2 at 09:30 UTC :rocket:
nora: Telemetry we want: `billing.provisional_emitted`, `billing.provisional_confirmed`, `billing.provisional_dedupe_rate` and an alert if dedupe_rate drops below 99% during rollout.
jamal: I'll prototype router header patch and add tests for handoff + kv-evict scenario. Alyssa can you capture one more full trace with replay id?
alyssa: On it. I'll attach trace and a small reproducer script in the ticket. Also adding a quick mock explaining UX copy for the console: "Provisional tokens are provisional measurements emitted during session resume; they are reconciled when the session finalizes." :thumbsup:
rick: Cool. Let's keep the default console view to include provisional but not include them in billing exports until confirmed. That buys dev visibility without charging surprises.
alyssa: Sounds good. Thanks all.
